name: depth_nav_test_point_lio
description: R1 depth-nav test, 199 s: the live Point-LIO fell behind (6 s processing lag on the Orin) and jumped ~13 m at ~88 s. Standalone Rust Point-LIO rerun offline on the same Mid-360 lidar + IMU (device clock, shifted onto the host clock); the recorded, diverged Point-LIO is the baseline.
